transcript.text: Thanks, Priya. From my perspective, what would make the handoff workable is a clear, documented split: I would own all client-facing escalation communication — being the single point of contact for the client during an escalation — and Omar would own the internal root-cause follow-up, coordinating with Implementation to track down the underlying issue and drive resolution. That way the client always knows who's talking to them, and the internal investigation has a clear owner without the two of us stepping on each other's toes. The key thing is that this needs to be written into the operating documentation so it's not just an informal understanding — that's where I think we've run into trouble before.
